accuracy_notes: Simplified exterior interpretation of the original 1985 four-door Saga sedan, informed by Proton's heritage exhibit photograph. Boxy silhouette, twin horizontal grille bars and rectangular lamps are represented; body curves, dimensions, wheel design, glazing and lamp details are approximate. Opaque glazing; no modeled interior, engine or opening doors. No exact trim, engine specification or factory paint match is claimed. This is not a scanned or engineering-accurate replica.
